title: Design Revisions on a Commission: Points Answered for the Studio Desk
content:
# Design Revisions on a Commission: Points Answered for the Studio Desk

Each programme of Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions includes a set number of design revisions in the quoted total, and the allowance is granted when the customer approves the design. The allowance is granted only while the commission stands at deposit pending, in production or on hold, and it is granted once on each commission. A revision taken while the allowance remains is drawn from it without charge; a revision taken once the allowance is used up carries the programme's charge for an additional revision. A revision is recorded with the number it bears on the commission, counting from one, so two revisions taken on the same day remain distinguishable. Revisions are taken only before production begins; once the piece is in production a change to the design is handled as a change to the specification and not as a revision.

**When is the allowance granted, and how often?** On the customer's approval of the design, once on each commission, and only while the commission record shows it standing at deposit pending, in production or on hold. The stage is read from the commission record, correlated by its commission reference, before the grant is made.

**Which revisions are drawn free and which are charged?** A revision taken while the revisions already drawn stand below the programme's included number is drawn from the allowance without charge. A revision taken once the revisions drawn have reached that number carries the programme's charge for an additional revision.

**How is one revision told apart from another taken the same day?** By the number it bears on the commission, counting from one.

**A customer asks for the design to be altered once the piece is in production. Is that a revision?** No. Revisions are taken only before production begins; after that the alteration is a change to the specification.

**What else does the design work include?** A computer rendering and a wax or resin model are prepared within the quoted total under the programmes that include them, and the first design is presented within the programme's design lead time in business days.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Under a programme that includes 2 revisions: the first and the second revisions taken are drawn from the allowance without charge; the third, taken when 2 have already been drawn, carries the programme's charge for an additional revision.
